Minutes if you buy both items on the Market; many attempts (bosses with a 20 h wait and rare drops) if you hunt them yourself. The base outfit requires the Feaster of Souls Quest to be completed (several days).

The {wiki:Poltergeist Outfits|Poltergeist Outfits} belong to the {wiki:Feaster of Souls Quest|Feaster of Souls Quest}: you receive the base outfit automatically when you defeat {creature:The Pale Worm}, at the end of that quest. The first addon (the cloak) is earned by using a {item:Spooky Hood} and the second (eyes and shoulder piece) by using a {item:Ghost Claw}. Both items drop, rarely, from four of the quest's bosses ({creature:Brain Head}, {creature:The Unwelcome}, {creature:The Dread Maiden} and {creature:The Fear Feaster}) and can also be bought on the Market. With the full outfit you earn the achievement **Mainstreet Nightmare**.
Defeat The Pale Worm to earn the right to be a Poltergeist. Obtain rare ghostly materials to improve your outfit even further.
Para Norbert, north of the Jakundaf Desert (start of the Feaster of Souls Quest)
**Premium** account (the outfit and the addons are Premium only).
**Base outfit:** complete the {wiki:Feaster of Souls Quest|Feaster of Souls Quest} by defeating {creature:The Pale Worm}.

Only if you hunt the items yourself: a team of **up to 5 players** for {creature:Brain Head} or for the three minibosses of {wiki:Zarganash}. The areas open up during the Feaster of Souls Quest itself.
addon 1 (cape); rare drop from 4 bosses or buy it on the Market

Money for the boats (185 to 275 gp to Yalahar; to leave Yalahar, 400 or 800 gp with {npc:Captain Cookie} if you do not have {npc:Karith}'s routes yet) and for {npc:Harlow} (100 gp to Vengoth, 50 gp back to Yalahar)
Base {wiki:Poltergeist Outfits|Poltergeist} outfit (male and female), automatically when you kill {creature:The Pale Worm} in the Feaster of Souls Quest

Addons 1 and 2 of the Poltergeist Outfits
By using the {item:Spooky Hood} (addon 1, cloak) and the {item:Ghost Claw} (addon 2, eyes and shoulder piece). The base outfit these addons appear on is obtained in the {wiki:Feaster of Souls Quest}.
Both items are bought and sold on the Market.

The {item:Spooky Hood} and the {item:Ghost Claw} are **tradeable** (Market) and no NPC buys or sells them. If you do not want to hunt the bosses, buy them from other players: the effect is the same. The base outfit, however, always requires the completed Feaster of Souls Quest.
Keep any Spooky Hood or Ghost Claw that drops for you **during** the Feaster of Souls Quest: the four bosses that drop them are part of the path to The Pale Worm.

The four bosses have a **20-hour** cooldown each and the two items are **rare** drops (about 1.7% to 5.5% in the wiki's statistics, and some with no percentage because they are extremely rare). Expect many attempts, or split the effort between Brain Head and the three minibosses of Zarganash.
{creature:The Pale Worm} does **not** drop either item: you do not need to repeat the final boss for the addons.
1. Base outfit: complete the Feaster of Souls Quest

The base outfit is the final reward of the {wiki:Feaster of Souls Quest|Feaster of Souls Quest}. Here is the summary; for all the details (bells, potion, Burial Shroud, minibosses and maze) follow that quest's guide.

{npc:Para Norbert} is **north** of the {wiki:Jakundaf Desert}, the desert **west** of Venore and south of Kazordoon. Go on foot: from **Venore** head **west**; from **Thais** head **north-east**. To return, walk the same way back to the city. Next to him is the invisible portal to the {wiki:Brain Grounds}.
Invisible portal to the Brain Grounds
Do the four parts of the quest
Talk to {npc:Para Norbert} ({key:hi}, {key:yes}) and do the Feaster of Souls Quest to the end. It is split into four parts, each with its own boss:
{creature:Unaz the Mean}, {creature:Irgix the Flimsy} and {creature:Vok the Freakish}
{creature:The Unwelcome}, {creature:The Dread Maiden}, {creature:The Fear Feaster} and, at the end, {creature:The Pale Worm}
up to 5 (minibosses) and up to 10 (The Pale Worm)
All the bosses have a 20-hour cooldown, including the final one: expect it to take several days. The {wiki:Feaster of Souls Quest|Feaster of Souls Quest} guide explains each part step by step.

After the three minibosses of Zarganash and the maze (you need **2** {item:Death Toll|Death Tolls} to enter), the team (up to 10 players) faces {creature:The Pale Worm}. When you win you **automatically** receive the base Poltergeist outfit. Then report to {npc:Para Norbert} to close the quest (achievement **Beyonder**).
Official artwork of the Poltergeist Outfits
2. Where the Spooky Hood and the Ghost Claw come from
Both addon items come from the same place: four bosses of the Feaster of Souls Quest, or the Market.
Quick option: buy on the Market
Look for **Spooky Hood** and **Ghost Claw** on the Market at any depot and buy them. No NPC sells or buys them; the price is set between players. If you buy them, skip to section 5.

The {item:Spooky Hood} ("Every time you look away you have a strange feeling, as if something watches you from its depths.") and the {item:Ghost Claw} ("It is glowing in an unhealthy light.") emit light (3 sqm) and weigh 12.50 oz and 7.30 oz.

If you would rather hunt them, these are the four bosses that can drop the two items (percentages estimated by the wiki from 55 to 60 kills of each boss; "very rare" means it has dropped, but with no calculated percentage):
All of them have a **20-hour** cooldown. The three in Zarganash are in the same area, so you can try them on the same visit.

{creature:Brain Head} (230,000 HP, 50,000 experience) is the boss of the first part of the Feaster of Souls Quest (*Drain the Brain*). Once you have unlocked that fight in the quest, you can try it again whenever the 20-hour cooldown ends.
Go to {npc:Para Norbert} (see section 1). Right next to him is the invisible portal to the {wiki:Brain Grounds}: it looks like **sand**. Step into it.
Invisible portal to the Brain Grounds

Go down **2 floors** to the area that, in the quest, was blocked until you handed the souls to Para Norbert: that is where the fight against Brain Head is. Along the way there are {creature:Grim Reaper|Grim Reapers} and Lost Souls.
The yellow floor (the *ulcer*) takes a percentage of your maximum health as earth damage every now and then, more the further down you go (**15%**, **20%** and **25%**).
Gather your team (**up to 5 players**). You have **5 minutes** to kill the boss.
**Energy** (heals it) or **fire** (only takes 30%, and the boss page says it also heals it)
There are several {creature:Cerebellum} in the room. Before focusing on the boss, kill the one in the **north-east** and then the ones around Brain Head. That is usually enough.
With those Cerebellum dead, focus on {creature:Brain Head} with **ice** damage. The team can use {item:Poison Bomb Rune|Poison Bomb Runes} to keep the {creature:Bad Thought|Bad Thoughts} away.
The Bad Thoughts' energy attack hits a 2-square radius around the target and **heals Brain Head** if he is within range.
If you do not kill him within 5 minutes, you are teleported out of the room and can only try again **20 hours** later.

Open Brain Head's corpse. Besides {item:Crystal Coin|Crystal Coins}, {item:Diamond|Diamonds}, {item:White Gem|White Gems} and potions, it can drop the {item:Spooky Hood} (about 1.7%) or, very rarely, the {item:Ghost Claw}. If nothing drops, come back after the 20 hours.
Possible Spooky Hood or Ghost Claw, 50,000 experience

The wiki does not describe another exit: go back up the floors the same way to the point where you arrived and leave the way you came in, back to {npc:Para Norbert}. From there walk back **east** to Venore (or **south-west** to Thais).
4. Hunting in Zarganash (The Unwelcome, The Dread Maiden, The Fear Feaster)
The three minibosses of {wiki:Zarganash} (teams of **up to 5 players**, 20-hour cooldown each) also drop the two items. You get there through an invisible teleport in {wiki:Vengoth}.

Take a boat to **Yalahar** ({key:hi}, {key:yalahar}, {key:yes}): from Thais with {npc:Captain Bluebear} (200 gp), from Carlin with {npc:Captain Greyhound} (185 gp), from Darashia with {npc:Petros} (210 gp), from Ankrahmun with {npc:Captain Sinbeard} (230 gp) or from Liberty Bay with {npc:Jack Fate} (275 gp). {npc:Captain Fearless}, in Venore, does not go to Yalahar: from Venore, first take a boat to one of these cities.

In Yalahar, go to the **Trade Quarter** docks (straight **south** from the main gate) and talk to {npc:Harlow}: {key:hi}, {key:vengoth}, {key:yes} (100 gp). He drops you off in the **west** of {wiki:Vengoth}.
Harlow only takes you once you have done the {wiki:Blood Brothers Quest} up to mission 4.
Walk **north-east** to the invisible teleport to {wiki:Zarganash}, at the coordinate point, and step into it. Use the map to reach each miniboss's room.
Map of Zarganash: path to each miniboss and the final boss
Zarganash is a hunting area for level 300+, full of {creature:Flimsy Lost Soul|Flimsy}, {creature:Mean Lost Soul|Mean} and {creature:Freakish Lost Soul|Freakish Lost Souls}.

{creature:The Unwelcome} takes almost no direct damage (about 10% from all elements) and uses {wiki:Lifesteal}: keep it away from the other creatures and the team. The room is large: put the team by the **west** wall and leave the boss on the **east** side (that way Druids can also use {spell:Terra Wave}). Attack {creature:Brother Worm}, which keeps appearing and disappearing in the **centre** of the room: damage dealt to it is what hurts the boss. Keep going until The Unwelcome dies.
{creature:Wormling|Wormlings} spawn non-stop and, when they die, explode for **750 earth damage** in a 2-square radius. Several dying at once can kill careless mages.
Can drop (very rarely) the Spooky Hood or the Ghost Claw

In {creature:The Dread Maiden}'s room (300,000 HP) coloured ghosts appear: {creature:Red Soul Stealer}, {creature:Green Soul Stealer} and {creature:Blue Soul Stealer}. They make the boss stronger, so the shooters should lure each ghost to a **vortex of the same colour**, where it disappears.
If a Soul Stealer passes through a vortex of **another** colour, it deals area damage or heals the boss.

The ghosts only change target with {spell:Challenge}. The blocker should take the Dread Maiden straight to the **north-east** corner of the room and keep her there while the shooters deal with the ghosts. A second Knight, a Paladin or {creature:Fire Elemental|Fire Elementals} help to trap her. Keep attacking: at first she is strong against all damage, but she weakens until she takes normal damage and dies easily.
Do not use **death** damage (it heals her); **fire** does 110%.
Can drop the Spooky Hood (~1.7%) or the Ghost Claw (~1.7%), 72,000 experience

It is the most dangerous of the three. In {creature:The Fear Feaster}'s room (290,000 HP) there are also {creature:Horror|Horrors} (jesters), {creature:Phobia|Phobias} (tarantulas) and {creature:Fear|Fears} (blightwalkers). Start with the Phobias, which are easy. The Horrors heal each other and the boss, but they attack from range and the shooters can handle them (mages, careful: their damage is considerable); as long as they do not attack the blocker, you do not need to kill them. The Fear can be blocked together with the boss.
**Death** damage heals the Fear Feaster: avoid it. It takes 110% from physical, fire and energy.

About **30 seconds** after the start, the team is teleported to a small room with the {creature:Symbol of Fear}. It is a stationary totem, but everyone in the room takes ever-increasing **death** damage: destroy it quickly to return to the main room. This repeats a few times until the Fear Feaster dies.
The longer you stay in the Symbol of Fear room, the more damage you take.
Can drop the Spooky Hood (~5.5%, the best drop of the four bosses) or, very rarely, the Ghost Claw

The wiki does not describe the exit: go back the way you came to the teleport you entered through and exit to Vengoth. There, walk **south-west** to {npc:Harlow} and say {key:hi}, {key:yalahar}, {key:yes} (50 gp) to return to the Trade Quarter docks in Yalahar. To leave Yalahar, go to the harbour: {npc:Karith} (on the boat, 1 floor up) takes you to Ab'Dendriel, Ankrahmun, Carlin, Darashia, Liberty Bay, Port Hope, Thais or Venore, but only after you have done the *Searoutes around Yalahar* mission of the {wiki:In Service of Yalahar Quest}. Without that mission, use {npc:Captain Cookie}, on the boat to the left of Karith's: he takes you to Liberty Bay (400 gp) or Thais (800 gp).
5. Use the items and get the addons
Once you have the items, just use each one. The addons appear on the Poltergeist outfit, which you receive when you finish the Feaster of Souls Quest (section 1).
Use the {item:Spooky Hood} (right-click → *Use*). The message *"The spooky hood is yours!"* appears and you receive the **first addon** (the cape) of the Poltergeist Outfits.
Second addon: eyes and shoulder piece
Use the {item:Ghost Claw}. The message *"You can use the ghost claw now!"* appears and you receive the **second addon** (the eyes and the shoulder piece).
Male Poltergeist with addon 2 (eyes and shoulder piece)
Female Poltergeist with addon 2 (eyes and shoulder piece)
With the base outfit and both addons you earn the achievement **Mainstreet Nightmare** (2 points): *"Now you are able to wander around Tibia wearing an angst-inducing vestment."*

Summary: **base outfit** = kill {creature:The Pale Worm} in the {wiki:Feaster of Souls Quest}; **addon 1** (cape) = use a {item:Spooky Hood}; **addon 2** (eyes and shoulder piece) = use a {item:Ghost Claw}. Both items drop from {creature:Brain Head}, {creature:The Unwelcome}, {creature:The Dread Maiden} and {creature:The Fear Feaster}, and are sold on the Market.
Achievement **Mainstreet Nightmare**: 2 points, Premium, not secret.
On the 2nd floor of the Brain Grounds there is a portal to the {wiki:Netherworld} ({coord:31904,32347,9}); the three Netherworld minibosses (solo) do not drop the addon items.
